remarks: Immaculate 1-Bedroom Condo in Desirable Winnipauk Village Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this beautifully maintained one-bedroom condo, located in the highly sought-after Winnipauk Village. Recently refreshed with a fresh coat of paint, this unit features a stunning cherry kitchen with stainless steel appliances, complemented by a versatile peninsula with ample storage and seating for six-ideal for both cooking and entertaining.  The spacious bedroom boasts a walk-in closet in-unit. An in unit washer and dryer adds convienience. Step through the sliding glass door to a private patio overlooking serene wooded views at the edge of the property.  Additional Highlights: Reserved parking spot directly in front of the unit, with convenient access to visitor parking Community amenities include a pool, clubhouse with a fitness center, and a racquetball court Beautifully landscaped and meticulously maintained complex Applicants must have excellent credit. Owner is related to the listing agent.
